title: mlfow_example
summary: An example MLflow pipeline demonstrating model training, tracking, and serving via a custom PyFunc wrapper backed by a Docker-based MLflow setup. It trains and wraps an SDV CTGAN synthesizer as the model artifact, using sdv.tabular's CTGAN and sdv.evaluation's evaluate function for training and quality evaluation.
evidence: pipeline/train_model.py:11-13: 'from sdv.tabular import CTGAN' and 'from sdv.evaluation import evaluate'; CTGAN.load/sample used in SDVWrapper.predict
